attr.title: MotionRec
attr.desc: MotionRec is a recording puzzle action game where you progress through stages by recording and playing back your own movements.
attr.inst: Purchase the game on Steam and copy all game files into assets folder. Patching can be very long on devices with 1GB RAM, up to about an hour. Also the game can take few minutes to load, so be patient.
attr.inst_md: Purchase the game on [Steam](store.steampowered.com/app/2602230/MotionRec/) and copy all game files into `assets` folder. Patching can be very long on devices with `1GB RAM`, up to about an hour. Also the game can take few minutes to load, so be patient.
